source.storage: read-only master kept privately outside Git (never shipped)

fit.measuredOn: the simplified mesh in source units (its extremes are what ships)

transform: no rotation, uniform scale 0.120135 about the bounds' bottom centre (source offset -0.001013, -1.001362, -0.001024): grounded (min y = 0), centred on x / z; baked into the vertices (identity node)

rebakeReason: the source atlas has 1361 UV charts: a seam-preserving collapse stalls at 3086 triangles (> the 3000 budget) and collapsing across the seams smears the texture between charts

simplify.tool: lib/dense.mjs simplifyGeometry (meshoptimizer 1.3 simplify, Permissive, geometry only; position weld)

bake.tool: lib/bake.mjs (closest same-facing source surface; base colour + metallic-roughness texels bilinear; normal from the source surface normals)
bake.notes: base colour re-baked from the source (no metallic-roughness / normal map in the source: constant factors kept)

textures: the source appearance re-baked onto a fresh atlas (processing of the source maps, no new / hand-painted art): JPEG (mozjpeg, 4:4:4) — base colour q85, metallic-roughness q88, normal q90; source material factors kept
